summary: Closed the order-dependent masking where a real-path collision between two __WHOLE_TREE__-sentinel-declaring tasks was relabeled as a bare whole-tree claim. Phase 1 pinned both declaration orderings with a new WHOLE-TREE-REAL-PATH-PRECEDENCE fixture (RED on sub-case B as predicted). Phase 2 added scopes_overlap_first_preferring_concrete to file-scope-overlap.sh and switched orchestrate-batch-admit.sh's one per-peer overlap call to it, taking the fixture green (16/16) with every pre-existing assertion untouched, the roadmap lint suite green (15/15), and the touched-path-narrowed battery green (24/24). Phase 3 redeployed the core extension (deploy-headless.sh, RESULT=landed_verify_clean), confirmed the deployed scripts are byte-identical to the source store, and re-ran both suites green against the deployed tree.
